answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize verified biometric or social graph anchors to create an oasis of authentic identity in a digital landscape. By tethering participation to unique physical entropy rather than computation, the system withstands a gale of adversarial bot activity. This mechanism forces an attacker to acquire distinct, non-fungible human credentials, turning the tide against mass-generated nodes by imposing a linear capital cost that renders high-scale Sybil attacks economically irrational.
